component.name: Avro Linux
component.summary: Bangla phonetic input method and preferences for IBus

description.p: Avro Phonetic is a modern Linux implementation of the popular Avro Phonetic Bangla typing method. It works as an IBus input method engine, allowing users to type phonetically in Latin script and have it transliterated on-the-fly to Bengali Unicode text.

Features include rich phonetic transliteration rules, dictionary-based suggestions, suffix inflection handling, customizable preview windows, the fixed keyboard layouts of Avro Keyboard (National (Jatiya), Probhat, Bornona, Avro Easy and Munir Optima), and an integrated GTK preferences interface.

developer.name: MD Shifat Bin Siddique Urfi and Avro Linux Contributors

description.p: The fixed keyboard layouts of Avro Keyboard (Avro Easy, Bornona, Munir Optima, National (Jatiya), Probhat) with its Modern and Old Style Typing, a Layout Viewer for them, TopBar start on login, and an Avro Doctor fix.
New Avro TopBar re-created from Avro Keyboard 5 for Windows, with real Bangla keyboard layouts, system tray, transparency, skins and command-line control.
Windows-style Preview Window, correct Bangla font rendering and engine fixes.
Avro Linux release with modernized GTK preferences, privacy hardening, and full regression testing.
